name: @orbb/timeline
description: Patient timeline API for ORBB (M7-B A49, Lane A): a pure, deterministic, care-team-authorized longitudinal assembly of a person's health record into an ordered, paginated, provenance-preserving timeline — the frozen observation|task|intent entry union with the ReconciliationService doctrine mirror (ONE canonical entry per same-metric set, per-source provenance, data never discarded), the @orbb/db cursor law mirrored in-package (opaque base64url anchor tuple, page-stable, forward-only, fail-closed), inclusive UTC-ms windowing, and THE exit-criterion gate: every read goes through @orbb/clinical's REAL evaluateCareTeamAccess with the frozen timeline:read scope — deny-by-default absolute, every clinical deny reason mapped to a typed all-or-nothing timeline denial, every decision audited and emitted as a TIMELINE_READ event. Interface-driven: injected store ports/clock/id-factory; ZERO db imports; ZERO external runtime dependencies (@orbb/clinical + @orbb/domain workspace links only; @orbb/measurement and @orbb/testkit are TYPE-ONLY imports). Boundary-shaped, non-authoritative, SYNTH-fixtured.
